properties.description: The server's write-through: a doorbell rung on every write, a debounced task (2s quiet, 10s ceiling) that coalesces a burst into one export, and the hand-edit guard that declines rather than overwrite. Tracks the baseline twice — in-process and via the recorded sync — so the guard also fires on a memory-backed server with no graph_path, and so a session's own deliberate export never looks like tampering. Never passes accept_divergence: an automatic write that discards somebody's work is the one outcome that cannot be undone from the thing that caused it.
properties.name: auto_export.rs
